title: school-holidays.json: Portuguese school holidays, by network
description: From the committed calendar (content/school-holidays.yaml; D61): the school breaks of the continente, Madeira and the Açores for the year the file covers, each with its official source to cite. The file carries a review gate like the articles (D33): until a human sets reviewed, `breaks` is empty and the site builds no page and offers no filter. A low price fits a break when its departure and its return both fall inside the window (window.start <= departure < return <= window.end), the pontes' rule. No prices here: the site selects the matching rows of each origin's low-price file. Past breaks are listed too: the site keeps their pages (noindex, "já passou") and calls a break past when window.end is before the Lisbon date of meta.generated_at. Added in v1 (additive): an export without it has no meta.files.school_holidays.

reviewed.description: The calendar's review gate: false = draft, nothing published.

last_checked.description: When a human last checked the dates on the official texts.

source_name.description: How to cite it on the page.

window.description: Travel window: the evening before the first day off to the day after the last one.

origins.description: One page per origin of origins.json, in its order.
